topics.concept: Diffusion models generate images by reversing a noise process: start from pure noise and iteratively denoise with a learned network, guided by a noise schedule. The sampler discretizes the reverse stochastic differential equation, and step count trades quality against speed. The simulation demonstrates the schedule on 2D toy distributions.
topics.data_idea: Creates seeded 2D target distributions, adds scheduled Gaussian noise, and reverses it to show samples converging to the target shape.
topics.name: Diffusion Sampling Simulator
topics.real_world_use: Text-to-image systems use diffusion samplers to render images from prompts.

topics.concept: The noise schedule decides how much noise is added at each diffusion step and shapes generation quality: linear schedules are simple, cosine schedules preserve signal longer at the start. The tuner compares schedules by simulating reconstruction error across step counts. Schedule choice interacts with the sampler, so they are tuned together.
topics.data_idea: Simulates seeded forward and reverse diffusion under linear, cosine, and quadratic schedules and compares reconstruction error curves.
topics.name: Noise Schedule Tuner
topics.real_world_use: Image-model teams tune schedules when chasing sharper samples at fewer steps.

topics.concept: A variational autoencoder compresses inputs into a latent distribution, and its ELBO loss balances reconstruction against a prior that keeps the latent space smooth. Sampling nearby latent points and decoding them shows the smooth interpolations this prior buys. KL collapse, where the encoder ignores the latent code, is the classic failure mode.
topics.data_idea: Trains a tiny seeded VAE on synthetic blobs, then grids the latent space to visualize decoded samples and interpolations.
topics.name: VAE Latent Space Explorer
topics.real_world_use: VAEs generate faces, molecules, and music in research and creative tools.

topics.concept: A GAN pits a generator against a discriminator in a minimax game: the generator fakes data, the discriminator spots fakes, and both improve. Training is famously unstable, with mode collapse as the headline failure where the generator outputs one thing. The simulator tracks both losses on toy data to make the dynamics visible.
topics.data_idea: Simulates seeded generator and discriminator updates on 2D mixture data and logs loss curves plus sample diversity over epochs.
topics.name: GAN Training Simulator
topics.real_world_use: GANs still power high-resolution face and texture synthesis pipelines.

topics.concept: Sampling from a language model starts with logits: temperature rescales them before softmax, with low temperature sharpening toward the top token and high temperature flattening toward randomness. Top-k then truncates to the k most likely tokens. The sampler visualizes how the token distribution and output diversity respond to both knobs.
topics.data_idea: Builds seeded toy logit vectors and samples under temperature and top-k grids, reporting entropy and repetition rates per setting.
topics.name: Temperature and Top-K Sampler
topics.real_world_use: Every chat API exposes temperature and top-k to control output creativity.

topics.concept: Beam search keeps the k most promising partial sequences instead of greedily picking one token at a time. Wider beams explore more but cost more compute, and length normalization stops the search from favoring short sequences. The decoder shows how beam width changes the final sequence on a toy scoring model.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded token transition scores and runs beam search at multiple widths, recording the winning sequences and their scores.
topics.name: Beam Search Decoder
topics.real_world_use: Translation and code-generation systems decode with beam search for higher quality.

topics.concept: Nucleus sampling keeps the smallest set of tokens whose cumulative probability reaches p, adapting the candidate pool to the model's confidence: sharp distributions yield few candidates, flat ones yield many. This avoids the fixed-pool problems of top-k, where k is too big for confident steps and too small for uncertain ones. The simulator compares diversity and degeneracy across p values.
topics.data_idea: Samples seeded token distributions under top-p grids and measures unique-token rates and degenerate loop frequency.
topics.name: Nucleus (Top-P) Sampler
topics.real_world_use: Creative writing tools default to top-p sampling for varied, coherent prose.

topics.concept: Streaming emits tokens as they are generated so users see text appear word by word instead of waiting for the full response. The simulator models per-token latency with queueing and batching effects, then replays the stream with realistic timing. Time-to-first-token and inter-token gaps are the two numbers users actually feel.
topics.data_idea: Simulates seeded token-generation timings under load levels and replays chunked streams with measured gap statistics.
topics.name: Token Streaming Simulator
topics.real_world_use: Chat products stream tokens to keep perceived latency low.

topics.concept: Quantization shrinks models by storing weights in fewer bits: 8-bit and 4-bit formats cut memory by 2 to 4 times with small accuracy loss. Symmetric versus asymmetric schemes handle weight ranges differently, and per-channel scales preserve more quality than per-tensor. The simulator quantizes seeded weight matrices and measures error and size savings.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded weight matrices, applies INT8 and INT4 quantization variants, and reports size reduction and reconstruction error.
topics.name: Model Quantization Simulator
topics.real_world_use: On-device and cost-efficient serving stacks quantize models to fit GPUs.

topics.concept: LoRA fine-tunes by learning low-rank update matrices instead of touching all weights: the update is a product of two small matrices scaled by alpha over rank. Rank controls capacity, and adapters merge back into the base weights at inference. The simulator fits seeded low-rank updates and shows how rank trades parameter count against fit quality.
topics.data_idea: Synthesizes seeded target weight deltas with known rank, fits LoRA adapters at several ranks, and plots error versus parameter count.
topics.name: LoRA Fine-Tuning Simulator
topics.real_world_use: Teams fine-tune chat models cheaply with LoRA adapters per task.

topics.concept: A text-to-image pipeline chains three stages: a text encoder turns the prompt into embeddings, a diffusion model denoises a latent image conditioned on them, and a decoder renders pixels. Guidance scale pushes samples toward the prompt at the cost of diversity, and negative prompts steer away from unwanted content. The simulator models each stage on toy data.
topics.data_idea: Builds seeded prompt embeddings and runs a toy conditioned diffusion plus decoder, showing how guidance scale shifts output statistics.
topics.name: Text-to-Image Pipeline Simulator
topics.real_world_use: Creative tools chain encoders, diffusion models, and decoders for prompt-to-image generation.

topics.concept: Image captioning maps pixels to words: an encoder turns the image into features and a decoder generates a sentence, often with attention over image regions. The simulator uses seeded region features and a toy decoder to show how attention weights shift across regions as each word is produced. Caption metrics like CIDEr reward consensus with human references.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded image region features and reference captions, then decodes captions with simulated attention and scores them.
topics.name: Image Captioning Simulator
topics.real_world_use: Accessibility tools auto-caption images for screen readers.

topics.concept: Multimodal models fuse text and image signals: early fusion concatenates embeddings before the model, late fusion combines separate decisions, and cross-attention lets text query image regions directly. The simulator implements each strategy on seeded paired data and compares retrieval accuracy. Fusion choice decides whether the model truly grounds language in vision.
topics.data_idea: Creates seeded text-image pairs with labels, applies the three fusion strategies, and compares classification accuracy per strategy.
topics.name: Multimodal Fusion Simulator
topics.real_world_use: Visual question-answering systems fuse language and vision for grounded answers.

topics.concept: Cross-modal embeddings place text and images in one shared space so that a caption sits near its picture. Contrastive training pulls matched pairs together and pushes mismatched pairs apart, and zero-shot classification picks the label whose text embedding is closest to the image. The simulator demonstrates the geometry on seeded vectors.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded matched and mismatched text-image vector pairs and measures retrieval recall at k for the shared space.
topics.name: Cross-Modal Embedding Simulator
topics.real_world_use: Search engines retrieve images with text queries using shared embedding spaces.

topics.concept: Style transfer rewrites an image in the style of another by matching content features of one image with texture statistics of the other. Gram matrices of convolutional features capture style as feature correlations, while deeper layers preserve content structure. The simulator blends the two losses on seeded feature maps to show the tradeoff.
topics.data_idea: Synthesizes seeded content and style feature maps, optimizes the blended loss, and reports style and content loss trajectories.
topics.name: Neural Style Transfer Simulator
topics.real_world_use: Photo apps offer artistic filters built on style-transfer research.

topics.concept: Inpainting fills masked regions of an image with plausible content: diffusion-based methods denoise the masked area conditioned on the visible context. Mask size and prompt guidance control how much invention versus restoration happens. The simulator shows reconstruction quality degrading as masks grow.
topics.data_idea: Applies seeded masks of varying sizes to synthetic images and runs a toy diffusion fill, reporting reconstruction error per mask size.
topics.name: Image Inpainting Simulator
topics.real_world_use: Photo editors remove objects and fill the background with inpainting.

topics.concept: Super-resolution reconstructs high-resolution detail from low-resolution inputs, an ill-posed problem that generative priors fill in plausibly. Upscaling factor sets the difficulty: 2x mostly restores, 8x mostly invents. The simulator compares interpolation baselines against a learned-prior model on seeded patterns and scores perceptual sharpness.
topics.data_idea: Downsamples seeded test patterns at several factors, reconstructs them, and compares sharpness and error against interpolation.
topics.name: Super-Resolution Simulator
topics.real_world_use: Video platforms upscale streams to higher resolutions on the fly.

topics.concept: Interpolating between two embeddings and decoding the midpoints reveals what the latent space learned: smooth paths mean the space captured continuous concepts. Spherical interpolation follows the hypersphere instead of cutting through low-density regions, giving better samples. The explorer traces paths between seeded vectors and scores path smoothness.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded embedding pairs, interpolates with linear and spherical methods, and measures midpoint density and smoothness.
topics.name: Embedding Interpolator
topics.real_world_use: Generative art tools morph between prompts by interpolating embeddings.

topics.concept: Attention weights show which input tokens each output token looks at: the softmax of query-key dot products. Visualizing the weight matrix as a heatmap reveals patterns like attending to the previous token or to sentence starts. Multi-head attention runs several such views in parallel, each specializing differently.
topics.data_idea: Computes seeded attention weight matrices for toy sentences and renders per-head heatmaps with head-specialization labels.
topics.name: Attention Map Visualizer
topics.real_world_use: Researchers inspect attention to debug what language models focus on.

topics.concept: A transformer block is the repeated unit of modern models: multi-head attention with a residual connection, then a feed-forward network with another residual, each wrapped in normalization. Residuals let gradients flow through deep stacks, and layer norm stabilizes training. The simulator runs a seeded block forward and profiles per-component compute.
topics.data_idea: Builds a seeded transformer block, runs forward passes on toy sequences, and reports per-component timing and output statistics.
topics.name: Transformer Block Simulator
topics.real_world_use: Every large language model stacks dozens of transformer blocks.

topics.concept: Attention is order-blind, so positional encodings inject sequence order: sinusoids give each position a unique smooth signature, and learned embeddings learn one per position. Relative schemes instead encode distances between tokens, which generalizes better to longer sequences. The explorer compares position similarity patterns across schemes.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded position encodings under three schemes and visualizes pairwise position similarity matrices.
topics.name: Positional Encoding Explorer
topics.real_world_use: Long-context models rely on relative encodings to handle unseen lengths.

topics.concept: The context window caps how many tokens a model sees at once, and the KV cache grows linearly with it, which is why long contexts are memory-hungry. Sliding-window attention trades full coverage for constant memory, and retrieval can extend effective context beyond the window. The simulator models cache growth and latency versus window size.
topics.data_idea: Simulates seeded token streams and measures simulated KV-cache memory and attention cost across window sizes.
topics.name: Context Window Simulator
topics.real_world_use: Document chat products manage context windows to fit whole files in memory.

topics.concept: Stop sequences tell the generator when to halt: matching the stop string ends the response, and streaming pipelines must detect stops across chunk boundaries. Poorly chosen stops can truncate mid-word or let the model ramble past the intended end. The handler tests stop detection on chunked seeded streams.
topics.data_idea: Streams seeded text in random chunks with embedded stop strings and measures detection accuracy and truncation correctness.
topics.name: Stop Sequence Handler
topics.real_world_use: Chat APIs stop generation on custom sequences for structured outputs.

topics.concept: Log probabilities quantify how surprising each generated token was: low logprob flags tokens the model was unsure about. Summing them scores whole responses, and the gap between the top two tokens measures decision confidence. Surfacing uncertain tokens helps reviewers spot likely errors.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded token sequences with known logprobs and visualizes per-token surprise plus whole-response scores.
topics.name: Log Probability Explorer
topics.real_world_use: Eval tools highlight low-confidence tokens for human review.
